name: Takatsuki Hanoka
source:
Mari's younger sister.
She has excellent grades and is just as athletic as her older sister. She
is quiet but strong-willed.
She likes her older sister, but she also knows that she has a complex about herself, which makes her a little sad.
She is a member of the Kyudo club.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071013020509/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/ls/char.htm]official site, archived[/url]]
